declarations.description:
A text field for an amount of time, as in Jira time tracking and Toggl. It reads `1h 30m`, `90m`, `1.5h` (or
`1,5h`), `1:30`, `2 days 4 hours`, `1h30` or a bare `90` in `unit`, and stores the duration in seconds in `value`.

While typing, a quiet preview after the text (`= 1 hour, 30 minutes`) says how the text was read. When the field is
left, the text is rewritten in `format`: `short` (`1h 30m`, the default), `long` (`1 hour, 30 minutes`, in the
element's language) or `clock` (`1:30`). `largest-unit` and `smallest-unit` bound the units written, so with
`largest-unit="h"` two days read `48h`. `day-hours` and `week-days` set how long `d` and `w` are: time tracking
often counts a day as 8 hours and a week as 5 days.

`step` (seconds) rounds the value when the field is left, and Arrow Up/Down add or remove one `step` (one `unit`
when there is no step). `min` and `max` are seconds too.

It is a form control: under a `name` the form receives the seconds, `required` asks for a value, text that cannot be
read sets `badInput`, and `min`/`max` set the range flags. Its own message shows below the field once it is left
(or after a failed submit), and inside a `c2-form-field` the field shows it instead. The words each unit accepts and
every message are translatable. `parseDurationText()` and `formatDurationText()` are exported for tables and APIs.

cssProperties.description: Space between the icon, the text and the preview.
cssProperties.name: --c2-duration-input__value--gap

cssProperties.description: The colour of the preview after the text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-duration-input__preview--color

cssProperties.description: The size of the preview after the text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-duration-input__preview--font-size

cssParts.description: The box around the clock icon.
cssParts.name: icon

slots.description: Replaces the clock icon before the text.

members.name: field
members.description: Label and description handed down by an enclosing `c2-form-field`, which then draws the supporting line.

members.name: value
members.description: The duration in seconds, or `null` for none. In markup, a number of seconds (`value="5400"`).

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name. The form receives the duration in seconds.

members.name: unit
members.description: The unit of a bare number such as `90`: `w`, `d`, `h`, `m` (the default) or `s`. Arrow Up/Down step by it when there is no `step`.

members.name: format
members.description: How the duration is written once the field is left: `short` (`1h 30m`), `long` (`1 hour, 30 minutes`) or `clock` (`1:30`).

members.name: largestUnit
members.description: The largest unit written: with `h`, two days read `48h`. Days by default.

members.name: smallestUnit
members.description: The smallest unit written; what is left below it is rounded. Seconds by default.

members.name: dayHours
members.description: Hours in a day, `d`. Time tracking often uses 8.

members.name: weekDays
members.description: Days in a week, `w`. Time tracking often uses 5.

members.name: min
members.description: The shortest valid duration, in seconds.

members.name: max
members.description: The longest valid duration, in seconds.

members.name: step
members.description: Seconds the value is rounded to when the field is left (900 rounds to 15 minutes), and the amount Arrow Up/Down add.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown while the field is empty. Defaults to the translatable `e.g. 1h 30m`.

members.name: required
members.description: Requires a duration before the form can be submitted.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Prevents editing while keeping the value in form submission.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Prevents interaction and excludes the value from form submission.

members.name: error
members.description: Applies the visual error state and sets `aria-invalid`, showing `error-text`.

members.name: help
members.description: Helper text shown below the field.

members.name: errorText
members.description: Message shown below the field while `error` is set.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded to the text field.

members.name: text
members.description: The text in the field. Kept as typed while focused; rewritten from `value` otherwise.

members.name: touched
members.description: Set once the field is left or a submit fails: from then on its own message shows.

members.name: writtenValue
members.description: The value the text was last written from, so an outside change to `value` rewrites it.

members.name: valueAsText
members.description: The text as written in `format`, or `''` when there is no value.

members.name: select
members.description: Selects the text.

members.name: stepUp
members.description: Adds `step` (one `unit` without a step) a given number of times.

members.name: stepDown
members.description: Removes `step` (one `unit` without a step) a given number of times, down to zero.

members.name: formatBound
members.description:
`min` or `max` written as a duration (`1h`), or an empty string when it is not set. A wrapping `c2-form-field`
reads it for its range messages, which would otherwise show the raw seconds.

members.name: rounded
members.description: The value rounded to `step`.

members.name: badInput
members.description: The text cannot be read as a duration.

members.name: commit
members.description:
Rounds the value to `step` and rewrites the text in `format`, unless the text cannot be read. Returns whether the
value changed.

members.name: problem
members.description: The message for the field's current problem, `''` when it is valid.

events.name: input
events.description: Re-dispatched while typing, and when Arrow Up/Down changes the value.

events.name: change
events.description: Re-dispatched when the edited text is committed, after the value is rounded to `step`, and when Arrow Up/Down changes the value.
